propositions: AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md incorrectly state that --force override on transition and claim operations is CLI-only and not exposed over MCP, contradicting the 2026-08-18 operator ruling and shipped code in scratchy-leprous-galago.

The ruling rescinded the CLI-only policy and now allows --force on all surfaces (library, CLI, MCP), with auditability enforced via the ABSENCE of signed attestation rather than capability withholding.

MCP docstrings for transition_ticket and claim_ticket in _mcp_writes.py were already updated to reflect the force-everywhere model, but AGENTS.md and docs/user-guide.md documentation was not synchronized.

The documented audit model must shift from CLI-only restriction to absent-signed-attestation enforcement and CI-certification-check gating, applicable only to transition/claim --force, leaving other CLI-only statements (--allow-secret-pattern, bridge setup) out of scope.
